findings.quote: The condition is that \(16Y+1 \mid P(Y)\) for all \(Y \in \{1^2, 2^2, 3^2, \dots\}\)
findings.reason: The hypothesis quantifies over n, not y. After setting n=4, this divisibility holds only at the fixed value Y=y². Moreover, C=(x−1)/((y²+1)(4y²+1)) cannot be held fixed while varying y. Thus the unbounded-denominator argument does not establish R₀=0.

reason: The contradiction depends on replacing a divisibility at one fixed y with divisibility at every positive integer y, an unsupported strengthening of the hypothesis.
unresolved_obligations: Exclude x>1 for a fixed positive integer y using the condition for every positive integer n.
